summary: ECARX Holdings Inc. furnished a Form -6K disclosing that its US$50 million senior convertible note, issued to a U.S. institutional investor under an October 30, 2025 securities purchase agreement, matured on October 30, 2026 and was repaid in full and cancelled, with no notes remaining outstanding. A prior limited waiver dated October 14, 2026 saw the investor irrevocably waive rights to purchase additional notes, for which ECARX paid US$10 million consideration. No advisor or board recommendation was disclosed. The event is a routine debt maturity/settlement, not a special situation; watch liquidity and dilution headline risk.
